sections.body: Words are made of letters. There are 26 letters in the English alphabet: A to Z. 🔤
Letters can be BIG (capital) like A, B, C, or small like a, b, c.
Your name starts with a capital letter!
Find the first letter of your name on a sign, a box or a book.
Magnetic letters, writing in sand or tracing letters with a finger help. Start with the letters in your child's name.

quiz.q: Which one is a capital (big) letter?
hints: Look for the tallest, biggest shape.
A is capital and a is small. Find the capital one here.
quiz.explain: B is a capital letter. b is the small version.

quiz.q: How many letters are in the English alphabet?
hints: Sing the alphabet song and count!
It's more than 20 but less than 30.
There are 7 days in a week. The alphabet has a lot more: twenty-…?
quiz.explain: There are 26 letters, from A to Z.
